lessonTitle: 35. Volume. The volume of a box
lessonTitleEnglish: Volume. The volume of a box
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 5 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: Volume tells how many unit cubes fit in a solid; a cube with 1 cm edges has volume 1 cm³.
stages.headlineEnglish: Volume tells how many unit cubes fit in a solid; a cube with 1 cm edges has volume 1 cm³.

stages.headline: Volume of a box: V = a · b · c; of a cube: V = a · a · a.
stages.headlineEnglish: Volume of a box: V = a · b · c; of a cube: V = a · a · a.

stages.headline: Units of volume: mm³, cm³, dm³, m³; 1 dm³ is also called a litre.
stages.headlineEnglish: Units of volume: mm³, cm³, dm³, m³; 1 dm³ is also called a litre.

stages.headline: A cube has edge 2 cm. What is its volume?
